// why: One config that governs the WHOLE repo — src/, its specs, tests/ and scripts/ — type-checked only. tsconfig.build.json is the emit path and extends this. Two things depend on a root tsconfig.json existing: dev-lint's node-checks builds its TS Program from `tsconfig.app.json` or `tsconfig.json` (lib/program.mjs), so before this file all 36 typed rules skipped every file in the repo and said so on every run; and DL-STRINGIFY-GUARD treats a directory with one as a TypeScript project. Twelve frontends import src/ — it should be the most checked code here, not the least.
